post.originalText:
OPUS 5.5,WHAT THE FUCK IS THIS...

i asked it to put Attack on Titan gear into Minecraft and now i’m jumping off rooftops with two blades, hooking into pine trees and flying over a forest at sunset

no titans yet, the forest is completely empty and somehow that makes it feel even more like the anime

next step is adding the titans, imagine swinging through the trees and seeing a 15 meter one walking toward your house

or i could make the trees fall when you hook them and turn the whole forest into a death trap
